purpose: Qualify the already J1D-qualified native SWAP qbot response tangent through the real canonical prescribed-bottom-flux, transaction and public-result lifecycle, with accepted-only publication, exact rollback semantics and no second production nonlinear trajectory.

scope.physical_family: qualified C1R base MvG/KSATFIT family only
scope.boundary_control: native SWAP prescribed bottom flux qbot, positive upward / inflow from below

hard_gates: the canonical production reference path admits an explicit prescribed-qbot bottom-boundary control compatible with the J1D native SWAP qbot coordinate
the production solve computes d_h_bottom_d_qbot_swap from the accepted Newton Jacobian/factorization without a second nonlinear trajectory

the production Jacobian sign convention and tangent right-hand side are derived from and tested against the implemented residual convention rather than inferred from the J1D harness matrix sign convention
rejected or retried trials cannot publish a sensitivity produced by a rejected trajectory
rollback restores worker-local sensitivity context consistently with the physical trial context
the tangent and any factorization remain result/worker scratch and are absent from committed per-column physical state
the public sensitivity has an explicit availability flag and method/provenance classification
accepted sensitivity is transported through transaction/canonical/kernel result boundaries without an implicit qbot sign conversion
requesting the tangent leaves accepted physical state and mass accounting unchanged
the normal production tangent path adds no full nonlinear trajectory and at most the already qualified same-factorization tangent backsolve
columns or calls that do not request an interface sensitivity incur no persistent per-column state and no tangent backsolve
interval-level sensitivity semantics are explicitly defined when a requested interval contains more than one accepted internal substep
finite-difference trajectories, when used for qualification, start from the identical committed physical state and cannot substitute for the normal production tangent path

boundary_seam_policy.smooth_prescribed_flux_regime: ordinary response tangent may be qualified
boundary_seam_policy.boundary_active_set_change: classify and route; do not score as an ordinary smooth derivative mismatch
boundary_seam_policy.RossFast_internal_node_or_envelope_seam: retain the qualified J1C/J1D piecewise policy; do not smooth or average

prohibited: new RossFast table fitting as part of J1E
finite-difference production tangent as the normal path
putting tangent vectors, Jacobians or factorizations in committed column state
silently changing physical bottom-boundary semantics to obtain a tangent
claiming MODFLOW coupling qualification from J1E alone
claiming production admission before live qualification evidence passes
